producer_report.summary:
I split `briefs.rs` into four submodules under `crates/athena-context/src/briefs/` and broke up `reader_brief`. `briefs.rs` went from 2544 production lines to 1411, and its longest function is now 100 lines, down from 217. Brief text is unchanged. I copied the code ranges with a scratch program that I then deleted, so the strings are byte-identical.

`briefs.rs` declares each submodule and re-exports its public items, so `athena_context::briefs::` paths are unchanged. The `cargo test --workspace`, clippy and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` runs all pass.

- **`boundary.rs`:** the boundary words and fragments, the producer brief's banned-words and mirror-check sections, `boundary_scan` and `plain_boundary_text`.
- **`reader.rs`:** the reader types, reading rules and `reader_brief`. `reader_brief` is now a list of calls to seven helpers, one per section.
- **`planner.rs`:** `planner_brief`, `critic_brief` and their inputs.
- **`plan.rs`:** findings and plan rendering.
- **Test module:** it only gained import names.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`:** one new entry.

I kept `SYSTEM_FACTS` in `briefs.rs`: its `include_str!` path is relative, and moving it would have changed a string literal.

checks_run.note: briefs.rs 1411 production lines, longest fn 100, not over any limit; no new submodule is listed

checks_run.command: Grep for a tab character in crates/athena-context/src/briefs

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo run -q -p athena-cli -- status` on the candidate: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs shows under 1500 production lines and is not listed over any limit; no function in briefs.rs or the new submodules exceeds 200 lines (reader_brief included).
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo run -q -p athena-cli -- status`. briefs.rs: 1411 lines, longest fn 100, OVER = no. The new submodules are not in the table, which lists only files near a limit. They are 277, 178, 165 and about 540 lines, with `reader_brief` now a short list of helper calls.

criteria_check.criterion: New files under crates/athena-context/src/briefs/ (at least boundary.rs and a reader submodule) exist; briefs.rs declares each with `mod` and `pub use`s the public items, so `athena_context::briefs::` paths including boundary_words, boundary_fragments, boundary_scan, plain_boundary_text, BoundaryHit, reader_brief, ReaderInputs, planner_brief and critic_brief still resolve for other crates.
criteria_check.evidence: Created boundary.rs, reader.rs, planner.rs and plan.rs. briefs.rs declares `mod boundary; mod plan; mod planner; mod reader;` and re-exports every public item with `pub use`. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` compiled all dependent crates without error.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff only moves code, apart from visibility changes and splitting reader_brief into helpers: Grep for a tab character in the new files finds none (string continuation lines keep the base's indentation), and no string literal or brief text changes.
criteria_check.evidence: A scratch program copied exact line ranges with no edits to their content. I deleted it afterwards. Grep for \t in crates/athena-context/src/briefs returns no matches. I changed only `pub(super)` on 6 functions, imports, `//!` headers, and the split of `reader_brief` into 7 helpers with unchanged bodies. The reader, planner and boundary brief tests pass byte-for-byte, and SYSTEM_FACTS stayed in briefs.rs so its include_str! path is unchanged.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --workspace`: all existing tests pass, including the briefs tests and any test that reads source files as text; none is deleted or weakened in the diff (test module changes limited to imports).
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test --workspace -q`: every test result is ok with 0 failed, including 127 athena-context tests and the xtask policy test. The only change in the test module is the `athena_data::records` import list, which gained Finding, FindingSource, Forecast and Severity.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` with no warnings, and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean) and `cargo fmt --all` after the last edits. I did not rerun `cargo fmt --check` as a separate command. Athena also runs these checks again.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the briefs.rs split.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a `### Changed` entry under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md describing the four submodules, the re-exports, the `reader_brief` helpers and the measured sizes.

open_issues: I could not confirm the base had no tab characters, so I assumed the earlier nit does not apply here. Grep finds none in either the base file or the new files.
mistakes: I first ran `cargo fmt --all && cargo check ... | tail`, which the Bash policy denied. I reran the commands separately.
learnings: At this snapshot briefs.rs had 2544 production lines and reader_brief 217 lines (measured by `athena status`). It now has 1411 lines and a longest function of 100.
Child modules can use private items of briefs.rs through `use super::{...}`, so only items briefs.rs calls from a submodule needed `pub(super)`.
No test or xtask scan reads briefs.rs as text, so none needed repointing.
SYSTEM_FACTS, history_section and the governing-decisions functions stayed in briefs.rs. SYSTEM_FACTS uses a relative include_str! path that would change if it moved.
desires: A Bash-allowed way to search a persisted tool-output file; Grep on it was blocked by the working-directory rule, so I reran the suite quietly.
